What are Futures Studies and Foresight? Futures Studies is an interdisciplinary field concerned with how people understand, explore and imagine multiple possible futures. Foresight involves structured approaches for examining changes, assumptions and uncertainties to support decisions in the present. These approaches do not claim to predict a single predetermined future. Explore Horizon scanning Notice emerging changes and signals relevant to a question, sector or community. Question Assumptions Ask whose expectations guide the discussion and what evidence might challenge them. Imagine Alternative scenarios Consider contrasting possibilities, including futures that conventional plans overlook. Act Backcasting Start with a preferred future and identify plausible steps, constraints and collaborators in the present. Teaching futures from Pakistan Dr. Khatani's work combines Futures Studies and Foresight with Futures Literacy, higher education, responsible AI and local community engagement. His public research includes a Futures Literacy Lab for climate-related futures and scholarly work on intuition and imagination in scenario planning. Imaginative futures. My work sits at the intersection of futures studies, education, responsible artificial intelligence, and institutional change. I bring academic inquiry and practical foresight together to help communities identify possibilities beyond business as usual. Based in Karachi, I serve as an Associate Professor at Iqra University and participate in international foresight networks. I'm Dr. Salman Ahmed Khatani, a Pakistan-based futurist, academic and AI strategist. Through Futures Studies and Foresight, research and community engagement, I help people and institutions question assumptions, explore alternative futures and make responsible choices today.

My work sits at the intersection of futures studies, education, responsible artificial intelligence, and institutional change. I bring academic inquiry and practical foresight together to help communities identify possibilities beyond business as usual.

Based in Karachi, I serve as an Associate Professor at Iqra University and participate in international foresight networks. I founded Fiker Futures Academy to expand access to applied AI literacy and futures-oriented learning.
Foresight is not about claiming to know what happens next. It is about helping people explore uncertainty, question assumptions, and make more informed decisions in the present.

Core focus: helping learners and institutions understand AI capabilities and limitations, consider consequences and uncertainty, and make more responsible choices about adoption and use. Connected work This theme appears across Dr. Khatani's teaching, institutional training, public scholarship and his book AI Designing Tomorrow . His professional work also includes AI Literacy and future-ready education engagements for educational, corporate and public-sector audiences.
